newsitem.title: USA: i2 Technologies raised to outperform.
newsitem.headline: i2 Technologies raised to outperform.

text.p: EVEREN Securities said Thursday it raised its intermediate-term rating on i2 Technologies Inc, a supply chain managment firm, to outperform from market performer, reversing a downgrade made June 10.

-- "Although we still believe that the (second) quarter may not provide the upside we were originally looking for, and there is some risk involved, we believe that investors should focus on the long-term dynamics of the market and the fact that customers are becoming more aware and educated on the advantages of supply chain optimization software," analyst William Lanzon said in a research note.
-- Intermediate price target was raised to $61 from $40 and long-term was raised to $64 from $51, EVEREN said.
-- Shares of i2 were up 3-7/8 at 46-1/2 Thursday.
